blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in West Central
Falcon Manor — 22150 Dewdney Trunk Road

Built 2007, 58 units, by Falcon Homes (current listings). Listings describe wood-frame construction ("Frame Wood, Glass (Exterior), Stone (Exterior), Vinyl Siding" in one), 9-foot ceilings, underground parking and a courtyard setting set back from Dewdney Trunk Road. A listing aggregator records cats OK for a current unit — listing-level data only. Age restrictions: Not confirmed.
Era (Era One) — 22265 Dewdney Trunk Road and 22226 Brown Avenue

The first phase of the Era master-planned community by Johnston Meier Insurance and SwissReal Developments, on Dewdney Trunk Road between Plaza and 224 Streets. Current listings record units at 22265 Dewdney Trunk Road as built in 2022, with fitness centre, rooftop deck and garden, party room and EV charging. Unit counts conflict between sources: a building-directory listing headline records the 22226 Brown Avenue building as a 143-unit concrete development, while the project's presale pages describe Phase 1 variously as 143 market condos and townhomes plus 49 rental apartments, and as 192 condos plus 49 rental apartments across four buildings from 3 to 6 storeys — treat every Phase 1 count as not confirmed until the strata plan for the specific building is read. Tenure trap inside the project: the 49 Phase 1 rental apartments are non-market rental stock in the same phase, not strata condos — confirm which building and tenure a specific unit sits in. Published restrictions for the strata buildings: Not confirmed; a listing aggregator records cats OK for current units (listing-level data only).
The 222 — 12320 222 Street

A building-directory listing headline records a 62-unit wood-frame development, pets allowed (directory/listing-level data). Current listings market the building as "The 222." Year built and age restrictions: Not confirmed.
Canuck Plaza — 12096 222 Street
Named "Canuck Plaza" in current West Central apartment listings. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Southridge Terrace — 22230 North Avenue
Named "Southridge Terrace" in current West Central apartment listings. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Wildwood Terrace — 12170 222 Street
A listing aggregator records the subdivision/complex name as "Wildwood Terrace" and the property sub-type as Apartment/Condo. Year built, unit count and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Emerson (The Emerson) — 22315 122 Avenue

Built 2019 per current listings. A building-directory listing headline records a 69-unit concrete development, pets allowed (directory/listing-level data). Listings describe a greenbelt setting, exercise centre and underground parking, with one recording construction as "Frame Wood, Mixed (Exterior)" — construction is in conflict between the directory headline and listing text: Not confirmed until the Form B and depreciation report are read. Age restrictions: Not confirmed.
Inspire — 12109, 12133 and 12143 223 Street

By Platinum Group of Companies. A developer/realtor information sheet for the project records Building 3 at 83 homes and an estimated completion of January 2027 — so part of this project is presale product, and current listings variously record units as built in 2025 and in 2026; treat the build year per building as not confirmed until the strata plan is read. Listings describe a 5-storey building with fitness centre, yoga studio, social lounge, outdoor gardens and rooftop patio, and record cats OK (listing-level data). Total project unit count across all buildings: Not confirmed from the sources checked.
Magnolia Gate — 22255 122 Avenue
Named "Magnolia Gate" in current West Central apartment listings, which describe underground parking and a central location. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
223 North — 22318 Lougheed Highway

Named "223 North" in current West Central apartment listings, one of which describes the unit as an original show suite about a 5-minute walk from the West Coast Express. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.

items.t: Treat that as the page's working scope, never as a boundary citation.

Seam warning: several buildings that current listings classify as West Central carry street addresses at or just east of 222 Street (the Era, Emerson, Inspire and 223 North addresses in are 222–223 Street addresses).

Where the condo stock concentrates: the Dewdney Trunk Road / 222–224 Street downtown-west cluster (Falcon Manor, Era, The 222, Canuck Plaza) and the 122 Avenue cluster north of it (Emerson, Magnolia Gate, Inspire), plus low-rise stock along Lougheed Highway (223 North).

Transit anchors: Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Avenue) serves the west side and Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) sits at the east edge; both run weekday West Coast Express trains between Waterfront and Mission City. Haney Place Exchange and the R3 RapidBus are in the Town Centre to the east.

items.t: Flood and escarpment rules on the south and east edges: the Fraser River flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic and Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits secondary suites on floodplain properties; the escarpment policy area's east boundary is 224 Street, and a geotechnical report is required within 300 m of the escarpment crest. Which West Central lots are affected is per-parcel: Not verified at sub-area level.

blocks.text: Good to know about West Central

items.t: The sub-area's east edge is a classification seam, not a line on a City map. Document searches and comparable sets built on street numbers alone will split this cluster in two.

Era contains its own rental building. Phase 1 of the Era project mixes strata condos with 49 rental apartments in the same development — a unit's building and tenure, not the project name, decides whether the buyer gets a Form B, a depreciation report and a strata vote, or a tenancy.

The biggest "townhome" complex at the west edge is not strata at all. Brookside Gardens (20834 Dewdney Trunk Road, 44 units, built 1978) is a rental complex held as an investment property — it inflates the area's apparent attached stock and never trades unit by unit.
West Central's detached market was the city's slowest in September 2026.

There is no City recreation centre or library branch inside West Central. The Maple Ridge Leisure Centre (11925 Haney Place) and Maple Ridge Public Library (130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road) are both in the Town Centre to the east — "walk to the leisure centre" is true only for the seam buildings.

Transit anchors: Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Ave) serves the west side and Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) sits at the east edge, both running weekday West Coast Express trains between Waterfront and Mission City; Haney Place Exchange and the R3 RapidBus are in the Town Centre to the east; TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning, with designs, costs and timelines not yet determined.

items.t: Lougheed Transit Corridor: the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan was adopted January 27, 2026 per the City record (Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021), as the guide page states — cited here as adopted on that basis.

items.t: The two West Central pages do not agree on the area's schools. The guide lists seven schools; the home page lists five, with only Laity View Elementary and the two secondaries' corridor in common — and the guide's "7–12" span for Thomas Haney Secondary conflicts with SD42's 8–12 secondary structure. A buyer quoting either page's school list without an address-level locator run is quoting an unsettled list.

Guide-only claims carried as site copy, not verified fact: the Town Centre population figures on the page (just over 8,000 residents when its plan began; about 12,430 residents and 6,520 households in the 2021 Census), the Town Centre Area Plan 2025-update details (boundary expanded to include River Bend, designations cut from 11 to 7, a Town Centre Core designation added), the Memorial Peace Park and ACT Arts Centre details, and the Port Haney history statement are not verified against a City source pass. The guide's median detached lot figure (about 9,000 sq ft from MLS sales data) is likewise not verified as an official statistic.
The sub-area's demand signal is in its condos, not its houses.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in West Central Maple Ridge Guide

items.t: Form B (both cross-referenced complexes are strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — monthly fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, CRF balance, insurance summary, with rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and most recent depreciation report attached; within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. Listing-level pet/rental lines in are listing data, not bylaws.

Rental bylaws void: since Nov 24, 2022, no BC strata residential rental-restriction bylaw is valid; short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw. No directory "rentals not allowed" line was found for the two cross-referenced complexes in the sources read — if one appears, it is void in-entry for long-term rentals.

Fee-simple contrast — plainly: no strata, no Form B, no strata fees; municipal rules plus registered covenants/HOA only. No verified fee-simple complex exists in West Central — a listing calling Sherwood Park or Maple Villas "fee simple" contradicts the strata-fee record and needs a title check.

City zoning/plans: Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019; standard house zone RS-1 (s. 605 — min lot 668.0 m², width 18.0 m, depth 27.0 m, max coverage 40%); Maple Villas' listing records RM-1. OCP citation contested — flagged, resolved nowhere (7060-2014 vs 7998-2024).

Lougheed Transit Corridor — internal inconsistency flagged transparently: Dewdney Trunk Road is the cross-referenced complexes' own street; confirm a parcel's designation in the City's current document.

Suites/SSMUH: one suite per lot inside the single detached building, max 40% of gross floor area, not in the Floodplain Area; eligible single-detached/duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws — this affects detached lots around the complexes, not strata lots inside them.

Flood/escarpment: Fraser River flood construction level 6.7 m geodetic, no habitable floor below it on affected lots, Zoning s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on floodplain properties; Fraser River Escarpment policy area east boundary 224 Street, lots within 300 m of the crest require a geotechnical report on a Section 219 covenant. Per-parcel status not verified.
: (2) Thomas Haney "7–12" span error and the two pages' disagreeing school lists.

blocks.text: Good to know about West Central Maple Ridge Guide

items.t: The guide page and the area page draw different West Centrals — Town Centre/Port Haney framing and a feed to 223 Street vs a 207–222 Street working scope — and their school lists disagree (seven vs five, only part overlap). A buyer quoting either page without an address-level check is quoting an unsettled scope.
follows the City record and flags the conflict openly rather than harmonizing silently.

The biggest townhouse-form address here never sells a unit: Brookside Gardens' 44 rental townhomes (1978, 8 buildings, 3.86 acres) inflate apparent attached stock, while buyable stock is two older strata complexes east on the same road.
Demand sits in attached product, not houses, on the September 2026 evidence: detached 3% (city's lowest) vs attached 13% on the city's second-largest inventories in both splits.
Maple Ridge's OCP citation is unsettled (7060-2014 vs 7998-2024) — flagged in, asserted nowhere.

Sherwood Park — 21801 Dewdney Trunk Road. Strata

Current listings (MLS® and (as of November 2, 2026)) record Property Sub Type Townhouse, Area Minor West Central, built 1996, frame-wood construction, 2 storeys, with strata/association fees, caretaker, maintenance grounds and management among the recorded amenities, zoning recorded as strata, and listing text stating "Strata has a strong contingency" and naming the complex Sherwood Park. The listing record's pet field reads "Yes With Restrictions" (listing-level data — confirm on the Form B). Unit count: Not confirmed — no source checked publishes it. The explicit title wording ("freehold strata") is not printed in the listings read: title-level wording not confirmed — the strata basis is the fee, association, management and contingency record; the Form B and strata plan govern.
Maple Villas — 21707 Dewdney Trunk Road. Strata

A current listing (as of November 2, 2026) records Property Sub Type Townhouse, Subdivision Name Maple Villas, Area Minor West Central, built 1983, frame-wood construction, 2 storeys, zoning RM-1, with strata/association fees and maintenance grounds, management and snow removal among the recorded amenities; its pet field records cats OK, dogs OK, with restrictions (listing-level data — confirm on the Form B). Unit count: Not confirmed. The explicit title wording ("freehold strata") is not printed in the listing read: title-level wording not confirmed on the same basis as Sherwood Park above.

The area's one large townhouse-form address at the west edge, Brookside Gardens (20834 Dewdney Trunk Road), is a rental complex, not strata stock.

Maple Ridge community medians (not West Central's): Detached $1,131,000; Condos & Townhomes $525,000, $432/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 49 days on market. SnapStats publishes no sub-area median: Not verified at sub-area level.

items.t: Form B diligence (both counted complexes are strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and a summary of the strata's insurance, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. Lougheed Transit Corridor — adopted: the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan was adopted Jan 27, 2026 per the City record (Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021; the corridor ends at 221 St), directing growth around future BRT stations along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road — Dewdney Trunk Road is the counted complexes' own street.

Flood and escarpment: the Fraser River flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic, no habitable floor space may sit below it on affected lots, and Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on floodplain properties; the Fraser River Escarpment policy area's east boundary is 224 Street, and lots within 300 m of the escarpment crest require a geotechnical report on a Section 219 covenant. Per-parcel status: Not verified.

blocks.text: Good to know about West Central

items.t: The two West Central pages do not agree on the area's schools. A buyer quoting either page's school list without an address-level locator run is quoting an unsettled list.

The biggest townhouse-form address in the sub-area never sells a unit. Brookside Gardens' 44 rental townhomes (built 1978, 8 buildings, 3.86 acres) inflate the area's apparent attached stock in any form-based search, while the buyable townhouse stock is two older strata complexes a few blocks east on the same road.

West Central's demand signal is in its attached product, not its houses. In September 2026 the detached shelf moved at 3% — the city's lowest — while attached product moved at 13% with the city's second-largest inventory.

blocks.text: West Central home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

98 condos sold in West Central with a median price of $445,950 (the middle half sold between $390,000 and $515,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $534 per square foot, a median year built of 2015 and a median strata fee of $363 a month. 38 townhomes sold in West Central with a median price of $615,000 (the middle half sold between $526,250 and $674,500), taking a median of 42 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $458 per square foot, a median year built of 1989 and a median strata fee of $413 a month.
